note: This file is a pure configuration dictionary (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines model settings for PSPNet with a ResNet-50 backbone used by MMSegmentation.
summarize_model_config: summarize the PSPNet ResNet-50-d8 model configuration including backbone, decode head, and auxiliary head settings
review_pspnet_config: review the PSPNet model config with ResNetV1c backbone and PSPHead decode head for 19 classes
review_data_preprocessor: review the SegDataPreProcessor config with ImageNet mean/std normalization and BGR to RGB conversion
review_norm_cfg: review the SyncBN normalization configuration with requires_grad enabled for training
review_auxiliary_head: review the FCNHead auxiliary head config with 1024 input channels and cross entropy loss
